title: Launch Desk Note: Per-Style Unit Limit on Launch Pre-Orders (Pre-Orders & Back-Orders)
content:
**The limit.** For a Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Launch Pre-Order, the open units of one style across all of a customer's Launch Pre-Order reservations may not exceed the launch pre-order per-style limit of the customer's Marlowe Rewards tier on the reservation date. A customer without an open membership is held to the Marlowe Rewards Member limit. Cancelled and fulfilled reservations do not count. A second profile at the same shipping address does not create a separate allowance: reservations shipping to the same address are counted together.

**How the count is made**

- *Style*: units are grouped by style, so different sizes of the same style count towards one total.
- *Open units*: the units on Launch Pre-Order reservations in status reserved, awaiting consent, in production or allocated. Units on cancelled or fulfilled reservations are left out.
- *Tier date*: the Marlowe Rewards tier is read as it stands on the reservation date of the new reservation.
- *Address*: every profile's Launch Pre-Order reservations of the style that ship to the same address go into one count.

**Worked illustration (hypothetical limit of 2 units for the customer's tier)**

| Open Launch Pre-Order units of the style already held, all profiles at the address | New reservation of 1 unit |
|---|---|
| 0 | Within the limit |
| 1 | Within the limit (total 2) |
| 2 | Exceeds the limit |
| 2, of which 1 was since cancelled | Within the limit (open total 1, then 2) |

The figure of 2 is illustrative only. The actual limit is the one the customer's Marlowe Rewards tier carries.
